title: State the expected wall clock of the root-delta scale gate phase
outcome: State the expected wall clock of the root-delta scale gate phase
acceptance: A contributor reading the scale phase can tell a long run from a hang without killing the gate

completion.summary: The development guide states the observed duration of the root-delta scale phase as an observation of recent Windows debug runs, not a limit or timeout, and says the harness long-running notice is not evidence of a hang.
